name: Wake Up To Wellness (3 hour)

source.section: Format list (names only, no descriptions on the page)

review: Only the name and duration are published. Decision 13 decides which formats still sell. Home page gallery captions: "Beresford Estate, Womens Wake Up To Wellness Retreat", "Private group of professionals, Wake Up To Wellness Retreat". The Encounter Bay guide p.4 title reads "Immersive 8 hr Wake Up To Wellness Private Group Retreat", which conflicts with the 3 hour label here.
